core_obligations: Main step: show c_2 restricted to Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z maps into Z. Consider the commutative square with top arrow R_1 x_{s_1, U, t_1} R_1 to R_1 and bottom arrow R_2 x_{s_2, U, t_2} R_2 to R_2 induced by c, and vertical arrows a x a and a. By varieties-lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-product-map the scheme theoretic image of a x a is Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z; by commutativity of the square the image of the top arrow lies in the image of a, hence the bottom arrow maps Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z into Z, giving the arrow c_2|_Z : Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z to Z. Remaining structure: as in the proof of lemma-map-groupoids-on-perfect-field-image, i_2(Z) is contained in Z and e_2 factors through Z, and the same restriction argument shows the groupoid axioms of (U, R_2, s_2, t_2, c_2, e_2, i_2) hold for the restrictions to Z. Conclusion: (U, Z, s_2|_Z, t_2|_Z, c_2|_Z) is a groupoid scheme over S.
